name: wordpress
description: Recognises WordPress sites and records what they give away about themselves — the core version, the plugins and themes installed, the REST namespaces plugins register and the user accounts exposed — as findings. It reads the Map, not the traffic: it runs when an endpoint is put there, and it never sends a request of its own.

settings.label: Read the responses the Map was built from
settings.description: On: the plugin reads the page an endpoint was discovered in, and the responses served from it, for versions and REST data. Off: only the endpoints' own paths are read.

settings.label: Record the user accounts a site exposes
settings.description: Author archives, the REST users route and oEmbed replies name accounts without being asked.

settings.label: Record REST API namespaces
settings.description: A namespace core doesn't register is a plugin's footprint, even when that plugin serves no assets.
